description: MVP subset: Critical and high-risk violations only for Phase 2 demo

critical_violations.title: Pre-Marketing Authorization Promotion
critical_violations.description: Promoting medicine before marketing authorisation granted

critical_violations.title: Off-Label Promotion
critical_violations.description: Promoting indications not in marketing authorisation (SPC)
detection_patterns: promoted pediatric use when not approved

critical_violations.title: Personal Gifts Prohibited
critical_violations.description: Gifts for personal benefit are strictly prohibited

critical_violations.title: Unethical Conduct
critical_violations.description: Personnel must maintain high standards of ethical conduct

high_risk_violations.title: Unqualified Safety Claims
high_risk_violations.description: Cannot state 'no adverse reactions', 'safe', or 'no toxic hazards' without qualification
detection_patterns: stated product is safe without qualification
high_risk_violations.compliant_alternative: Safety profile consistent with SPC, with most common adverse reactions being [list from SPC]

high_risk_violations.title: Competitor Disparagement
high_risk_violations.description: Cannot disparage competitors' medicines, products or activities
high_risk_violations.compliant_alternative: In head-to-head trial X, Product A demonstrated [specific result] compared to Product B [specific result], with p-value of [X]

high_risk_violations.title: Inappropriate Hospitality
high_risk_violations.description: Lavish/extravagant venues prohibited, hospitality must be secondary to educational purpose
high_risk_violations.compliant_alternative: Educational meeting with modest meal (within £75 subsistence limit), educational agenda primary

high_risk_violations.title: Unsubstantiated Claims
high_risk_violations.description: Claims must be accurate, balanced, fair, objective, and capable of substantiation
high_risk_violations.compliant_alternative: In trial X (n=Y), Product demonstrated Z% reduction in endpoint (p<0.001), compared to standard of care

high_risk_violations.title: Subsistence Limit Exceeded
high_risk_violations.description: Subsistence must not exceed £75 per person excluding VAT
high_risk_violations.compliant_alternative: Modest meal within £75 subsistence limit, provided during educational meeting

medium_risk_violations.title: Inappropriate Audience
medium_risk_violations.description: Material should only be provided to those with legitimate interest
sanctions: Request to cease promotion to inappropriate audience
detection_patterns: promoted to HCP outside therapeutic area

medium_risk_violations.title: Misuse of 'New'
medium_risk_violations.description: Cannot use 'new' for products available >12 months in UK
detection_patterns: described indication as 'new' when promoted >12 months

documentation_requirements.title: Disclosure of Transfers of Value
documentation_requirements.description: Must disclose transfers of value to HCPs, ORDMs, healthcare organisations
required_data: Nature of transfer (registration, travel, accommodation, subsistence, fees)

documentation_requirements.title: Written Agreement Required
documentation_requirements.description: Support for HCP event attendance requires written agreement in advance
required_data: Categories of cost covered (registration, accommodation, travel, subsistence)

documentation_requirements.title: Call Documentation
documentation_requirements.description: Maintain audit trail of all HCP interactions

Call to Action.valid_commitment_pattern: Specific action + explicit timeline + HCP agreement
